summary: Martin Marietta Materials filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $5.5 billion aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes across five tranches (4.850% due 2029, 5.200% due 2032, 5.400% due 2034, 5.625% due 2036, 6.375% due 2056) under a base indenture and Sixth Supplemental Indenture with Regions Bank as trustee. The notes rank equally with existing senior debt, are unguaranteed, and are structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other transformative event is indicated. Focus remains on debt servicing and refinancing use of proceeds.
